items.title: Starlink’s new portable terminal runs for 4.5 hours on one battery charge and connects in 60 seconds. Mini 2 uses a quick-swap battery or plugs in via USB-C. It has built-in Wi-Fi and needs only a clear view of the sky. Preorders are open by invitation in the U.S

In February 2022, SpaceX launched 49 Starlink satellites into a solar storm so mild that forecasters rated it minor, and within days 38 of them had fallen back and burned up, because the storm had swollen the thin air they were flying through
